A '''glyphic writing system''' was used on the display screens of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and vehicles owned by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The system consisted of at least eighteen different glyphs.
